_meta.description: HEC Tenure Track System (TTS) lump-sum salary packages (all-inclusive, no separate allowances). Current package is the 2021 revision (35% increase over the 2015 package, effective 20-09-2021, Finance Division notification F.No.4(6)R-4/2016); TTS salaries have been frozen since (no ARA applied), per press reports as of May 2026.
_meta.source: Finance Division notification reproduced at HEC (https://www.hec.gov.pk/english/services/universities/FP/Documents/Gov.%20Notification%202021.pdf); figures cross-checked via https://fsconline.info/govt-increased-35-tenure-track-system-tts-pay-packages-2021/ and arithmetic consistency (min + 15 stages x increment = max); freeze status per https://tribune.com.pk/story/2606600/salary-freeze-tax-surge-hit-professors

notes.lump_sum: TTS pay is a consolidated lump sum covering all allowances; standard BPS allowances (HRA, conveyance, medical) are not separately admissible
notes.bps_gap: Policy intent of the 2021 notification: maintain a 35% gap between BPS and TTS faculty salaries
notes.high_achiever: Up to 15% of TTS faculty meeting benchmarks (h-index 25, 5000 citations) eligible for 100% increase instead of 35%
